# React Bits adaptations for CQA

Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz. MIT + Commons Clause; full text: LICENSE.md.
Pinned upstream revision: `4dc7b5b7772e1217c8fb8d2a7aa074302180e5b4` of https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits

- Color Bends: original fragment shader; native WebGL renderer replaces Three.js; Freedom palette and light-theme pigment output.
- Comet Dial: source arc geometry, twelve-part velocity trail and spring idea adapted to a read-only score visualization. Numeric scores and API decisions cannot be edited by this effect.

These files form part of the CQA application, not a standalone component library. Links: https://www.reactbits.dev/c/micro/comet-dial, https://www.reactbits.dev/c/animations/halftone-reveal, https://www.reactbits.dev/c/backgrounds/color-bends
